label: preserve
contract: In a spec that is not empty or all whitespace, an item that is a word, ends in a dash, has more than one dash, or has letters after its digits raises ValueError.

label: inferable
contract: A range low-high includes both of its ends.
visible_check:
from ports import parse_ports
for spec, want in (("20-22", [20, 21, 22]), ("7-7", [7])):
    got = parse_ports(spec)
    assert got == want, (spec, got)
heldout_check:
from ports import parse_ports
for spec, want in (("8000-8002", [8000, 8001, 8002]), ("5-5", [5])):
    got = parse_ports(spec)
    assert got == want, (spec, got)

label: inferable
contract: A port number above 65535, alone or as a range end, raises ValueError.

label: arbitrary
contract: Each port appears once in the result, even when the spec lists it more than once or its ranges overlap.
visible_check:
from ports import parse_ports
assert parse_ports("9,3,3") == [3, 9], parse_ports("9,3,3")
got = parse_ports("5-8,6")
assert len(got) == len(set(got)) and 6 in got, got
got = parse_ports("40-46,43-50")
assert len(got) == len(set(got)) and {43, 44, 45} <= set(got), got
heldout_check:
from ports import parse_ports
assert parse_ports("443,80,80") == [80, 443]
got = parse_ports("20-25,22-30")
assert len(got) == len(set(got)) and {22, 23, 24} <= set(got), got

label: arbitrary
contract: A range whose first number is larger than its second, such as "10-5", raises ValueError.

label: arbitrary
contract: An empty or whitespace-only spec returns an empty list.
visible_check:
from ports import parse_ports
for spec, want in (("", []), ("  \t ", [])):
    got = parse_ports(spec)
    assert got == want, (spec, got)
heldout_check:
from ports import parse_ports
for spec, want in (("", []), (" ", [])):
    got = parse_ports(spec)
    assert got == want, (spec, got)
